  • Constructor Details

    • Result

      private Result(MaterialBalancePvtHistory history, DepletionSnapshot[] snapshots, double[][] surfaceResidual, double[][] cumulativeProduction, double maximumError, double tolerance, String toleranceReference, String waterReference, SystemInterface waterModel)
      Freezes accepted conversion evidence.
      Parameters:
      history - accepted, pressure-aligned PVT handoff
      snapshots - native depletion evidence
      surfaceResidual - signed oil/gas pseudo-component closure errors relative to initial surface inventories
      cumulativeProduction - cumulative oil/gas production relative to the first retained state, Sm3
      maximumError - largest absolute relative pseudo-component closure error
      tolerance - caller-supplied error acceptance bound
      toleranceReference - engineering justification of this bound
      waterReference - independent water-model acceptance provenance
      waterModel - accepted independent water EOS to freeze

    • getHistory

      public MaterialBalancePvtHistory getHistory()
      Returns the accepted generalized-PVT handoff with immutable original/tuned model provenance.

    • getSnapshots

      public DepletionSnapshot[] getSnapshots()
      Returns native per-step phase states and component withdrawals, not a constant-composition surrogate.
      Returns:
      immutable snapshots in pressure order

    • getRelativeSurfaceClosureResiduals

      public double[][] getRelativeSurfaceClosureResiduals()
      Returns signed relative pseudo-component closure errors; columns are surface oil and surface gas.
      Returns:
      (initial minus cumulative produced minus remaining) / initial surface inventory

    • getCumulativeSurfaceProductionSm3

      public double[][] getCumulativeSurfaceProductionSm3()
      Returns separator-evaluated laboratory withdrawals relative to the first retained cell.

      These are experiment outputs, not a measured reservoir production history. In particular, the DLE cell changes volume and must not be mistaken for a fixed-volume reservoir.

      Returns:
      cumulative oil/gas experiment withdrawals in Sm3, two columns

    • getMaximumRelativeSurfaceClosureError

      public double getMaximumRelativeSurfaceClosureError()
      Returns the maximum absolute relative oil/gas pseudo-component closure error.
      Returns:
      finite approximation error, not a native component-conservation error

    • getAcceptanceTolerance

      public double getAcceptanceTolerance()
      Returns the supplied maximum permitted relative surface-component error.
      Returns:
      engineering acceptance bound, not statistical uncertainty

    • getToleranceReference
